technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing messy data room files of any format into reliable, source-linked financial analyses needs careful LLM and data engineering, but uses off-the-shelf models.

defensibility.rationale: Several AI diligence tools launched in 2024 and models are shared. SOC 2 Type 2 and PE workflow depth may help, but copying is feasible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition found through 2026; Keye announced its stealth exit with a seed round in July 2025.

market_need_then: PE funds screen many deals and diligence analysis by hand takes weeks; generative AI in 2024 made automated analysis of raw files plausible.

branding.domain_note: Uses keye.co rather than the .com; no acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Professional, investor-to-investor; site stresses security and time saved.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand itself was found; site is a conventional enterprise page. Name collides with unrelated KEYE trademarks.

outcome_analysis: Keye is active and raised a seed round in July 2025, about ten months after its Fall 2024 batch. The founders come from private equity and banking, which gives domain insight and access to buyers. It rides the timing of generative AI, but the segment drew several competitors, so durability is untested.
